en.headline: Police arrest 17 and seize HK$3.67m in crackdown on scam using Malaysian runners
en.dek: The syndicate recruited foreigners to collect cash from phone-scam victims and channel it through Mong Kok money changers and a crypto shop; 22 victims reported losses of about HK$2.5 million.
body: Hong Kong police have arrested 17 people and seized HK$3.67 million in cash in an operation targeting a cross-border phone-scam syndicate that used Malaysian nationals as cash runners.

Officers from the Kowloon West crime squad said the arrests related to “guess who I am” scams that targeted 22 victims between June and August, resulting in reported losses of about HK$2.5 million. The single largest loss was HK$700,000. Scammers typically impersonated relatives or friends claiming to need urgent cash for bail or emergencies.

The group recruited runners from Malaysia via social media, offering free flights, accommodation and daily payments of HK$500 to HK$1,000. Over the past two months police had already arrested 12 Malaysian men aged 20 to 48 on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud. In the latest action, codenamed Flash Assault, officers targeted three premises in Mong Kok used as transit points and a cash store — including a cryptocurrency exchange and money changers — and arrested five more people aged 21 to 54, including local staff and one Southeast Asian runner.

Police said the three locations had processed around HK$4.67 million in scam proceeds from 4 June to 14 August. In one case officers recovered the full HK$200,000 for a victim who had not yet realised they had been defrauded. The force urged money-service operators to remain vigilant over large or suspicious cash movements.

zh.headline: 警拘17人檢367萬 破招攬馬來西亞跑腿收騙款集團
zh.dek: 集團以日薪及包機票住宿誘東南亞人士來港收取「猜猜我是誰」騙款，經旺角找換店及虛擬貨幣店中轉；22名受害人報案涉款約250萬元。
body: 警方西九龍總區刑事部採取代號「閃襲」的反詐騙行動，拘捕17人並檢獲367萬元現金，打擊一個招攬馬來西亞籍人士充當跑腿收取電話騙案款項的跨境詐騙集團。
警方表示，案件涉及「猜猜我是誰」電話騙案，今年6月至8月期間共有22名受害人報案，總損失約250萬元，單一最高損失達70萬元。騙徒通常冒充親友，訛稱急需金錢處理保釋或其他緊急事故。
集團透過Telegram等平台以日薪500至1,000元、包機票及住宿作招徠，誘使馬來西亞人來港擔任跑腿。過去兩個月警方已先後拘捕12名年齡介乎20至48歲的馬來西亞男子，涉嫌串謀詐騙。今次行動再拘捕5人（21至54歲），包括本地找換店及虛擬貨幣店職員，以及一名東南亞跑腿，並搗破旺角三個用作收取及儲存騙款的據點。
調查顯示，上述三個地點在6月4日至8月14日期間共處理約467萬元騙款。行動中曾成功為一名尚未察覺受騙的受害人全數起回20萬元。警方提醒找換店及相關商戶提高警覺，留意可疑大額現金交易。
